outline:
典型神經網路之簡介與回顧、直傳式神經網路、監督式學習、非監督式學習、回傳式神經網路、神經網路之結構分析、學習方式分析神經網路之應用。
Introduction to traditional Networks, Feedback Neutral Networks ,Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning, Recurrant Neural Networks, Structure Analysis of Neural Networks, Analysis of Learning Methods, Applications of Neural Networks.
schedule:
Week 1_Syllabus and Overview
Week 2_Introduction to Neural Network
Week 3_Artificial Neural Network Architectures and Training Processes
Week 4_Rosenblatt Perceptron
Week 5_ADALINE Network and Delta Rule
Week 6,7_Multilayer Perceptron Networks
Week 8_Auxiliary Characteristics of MLP
Week 9_Application of MLP
Week 10_Radial Basis Function Networks
Week 11_Recurrent Hopfield Networks
Week 12,13_Self-Organizing Kohonen Networks
Week 13,14_Learning Vector Quantization
Week 15_Counter Propagation Networks
Week 16_Adaptive Resonance Theory Networks
Week 17,18_(Flexible Learning)Self learning on recent developments in Neural Networks

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: 觀看多部新穎神經網路、人工智慧或機器學習相關影片，理解影片介紹之技術、發展或應用內容，並撰寫學習報告，整理影片重點、心得與與課程內容之關聯。
flexible_learning.outcome: 學生能理解課程以外之神經網路相關技術或應用，整理與分析影片內容，並能將影片所介紹之概念與課程所學之神經網路架構與學習方法進行連結與比較。
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 20%：依據影片內容理解與整理、與課程內容之連結與分析、個人心得與反思、報告完整性等項目進行評量。

assessment:
作業與報告(Assignment and Report): 80%
期末作業(Final Assignment): 20%
